entries.EN: Damn it, it's all a haze now... I remember a truck... They drove me somewhere for a long time and my whole body hurt... There was darkness... What happened before that? I've no idea... So confused... Now this fat guy calls me the Marked One, probably because of the strange tattoo on my arm, and then there's this weird mission to kill some guy called Strelok on my PDA... Is it even my PDA? Looking at Strelok's photo I'm not even sure if I knew him or not... Dammit! It's all like a bad dream you can't wake up from! What to do? Where to go? And worst of all: who am I? OK, OK, calm down, control yourself. The first thing I'll have to do is do some jobs for this Sidorovich. He claims to have saved my life after all... That shouldn't be too bad. I'll take a walk, calm myself down and perhaps my head will be clearer.

entries.EN: So, I am going on my first deep raid into the Zone. The target is the Agroprom Research Institute. I need to recover some documents belonging to a military expedition. Apart from the mission the trader gave me some information about an area to the North, on the way to the Zone's center, where the "brains boil"... Probably more of a legend than a fact, but since there's clearly something wrong with my head I probably should take a look at it and talk to some people. You never know - maybe I've been there before... Also, the trader told me that Strelok discovered a way to get through the area and the traders want to know it. Their reasons are clear - they want to access untouched artifact fields. Well, I'm going to help them, I guess.

entries.EN: Well, well... Got some fresh air, saw the local wildlife... Interestingly I seem to remember some of it already, but it's all in a haze... Had a chance to try the local "amusement" called anomalies... Judging by the fact that I survived I've probably come across them before, but my brain stubbornly refuses to remember... Sidorovich is one clever bastard - he knows he can use me almost for free and that's exactly what he wants to do. Still, maybe he'll help me find this bloody Strelok fella... He's my only connection with my past.

entries.EN: I met up with Fox. It's that bad news, good news scenario. The bad news is that he knows little about Strelok. The good news is that his brother called Seriy knows more. It seems Seriy is in a hangar about 2 kilometers North of here, in some dump full of radioactive waste. My task is clear: get there before he leaves.

entries.EN: I am only a step away from the people who created this damn network of psi-units all over the Zone. The Monolith is just another zombifier it seems, with the exception that someone took the care to install a hologram in the shape of a huge crystal inside the sarcophagus. When the "lucky" ones approach it, it messes up their brains. Maybe it even makes them believe that their wishes have come true, who knows? Have I been affected by this shit before? I'm not sure, but whoever is behind this will soon be answering my questions. They even invited me... Well, here I come, you bastards!

entries.EN: A bit of the local folklore I picked up: Legend has it there is a wish-granting machine deep inside the Zone... The exact location is unknown but it's somewhere in the center. Apparently, all you need to do is get to it and... all of a sudden your life becomes much, much easier. Hmm... How about finding it and saying "I want to remember everything about my past!" Then again, I wouldn't want to waste a wish - what if I remembered everything and it turns out I am a complete bastard? Wouldn't that be a bummer. I wonder how many wishes it grants.

entries.EN: The night before we had to turn around, I had a strange dream: we all seemed to be walking in a chain behind each other, holding each other by the ropes around our necks. I don't know what it could mean, and I don't want to think about it. Eared pulled my leg, and I stepped on a rusty barbed wire and pierced my foot. That's not counting the two attacks by pseudo-dogs along the way. The only thing I still don't understand is: what are we doing here? We got a message the day before yesterday from the Captain: "...go to the junkyard and stay there until I call you, the main expedition objectives are postponed until further notice." Suspicious enough, but an order is an order. \n\n %c[255,255,128,0]On the excavator wreckage north-west of the equipment graveyard, I stacked some of my equipment.%c[default]

entries.EN: We should have pushed all the way to the Warehouses, and then all of a sudden, poof! We are ordered to retreat and lay low. No explanations given whatsoever. It was all set up so well, we had the vivacity, and the determination, and everything else you need before a difficult endeavor, only for it to evaporate into thin air. Well, at least we still have our fully stacked mags, so I guess we'll just sit out here, on the dump, just as the Captain ordered us to in his message, hoping that circumstances will change again soon. I have a burning suspicion I know what happened: I think that this rascal Crow, who volunteered to lead the vanguard detachment to the warehouses, had screwed something up or simply turned out to be a shitty guide, so he led the Captain and his vanguard into some impassable wilderness. Well, that'll teach them to pay more attention into who they trust and rely on in the future. \n\n %c[255,255,128,0]I hid something useful in the grove south-east of the swamp, under the largest dry bush there. Not a lot of people go there, except animals...%c[default]
